7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda: Price & Calories

A medium Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda is about $3.50, with 250 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 64 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Brew Lagoon Fizz at Home

Three syrups, equal parts, over sparkling water. The build order fans swear by is lime first, blue raspberry second, coconut last.

For one medium fizz

  • About 1/3 oz lime syrup
  • About 1/3 oz blue raspberry syrup
  • About 1/3 oz coconut syrup
  • 10 to 12 oz plain sparkling water
  • A full cup of ice
  • Optional: cold foam or a splash of cream
  1. Lime over the ice, then blue raspberry, then coconut.
  2. Sparkling water in slow. One gentle stir, or the blue streaks vanish.
  3. Foam or cream on top if you are going that way.

Blue-raspberry-forward variant: some fan recipes run 3 pumps of blue raspberry to 2 each of coconut and lime. Sweeter, bluer, more candy. Honest note: your home mix will not land exactly on the stand's 250 calories. Syrups differ. The flavor lands fine either way.

7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

A medium iced Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda has 250 calories. A small has 170 and a large 340, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

0 mg. Every fizz is caffeine free, this one included.

How much does a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Brew Lagoon 7 Fizz Soda?

64 g in a medium.

Is Brew Lagoon just Ocean Breeze with lime added?

That is exactly how fans describe it, and the official formulas back them up. Ocean Breeze is blue raspberry and coconut. Brew Lagoon is those two plus lime, which is why the Reddit shorthand is literally ocean breeze plus lime. They are still separate drinks on the menu with separate entries in the nutrition guide. Taste-wise the lime pushes Brew Lagoon sweeter and more tropical, while Ocean Breeze stays cleaner and sharper. If you order both in a week, you will taste the difference in the first sip.

Why is Brew Lagoon blue?

The blue raspberry syrup. There is no blue fruit in the cup, no butterfly pea flower, nothing natural doing that color. Blue raspberry is a candy flavor, and the color is part of the candy act. The lime and coconut are in there for taste. The blue is in there so a twelve-year-old points at your cup in the drive-thru. It works.

Is Brew Lagoon really almost zero calories, like one guide says?

No, and that guide is the top result, which is a problem. It calls this drink almost zero calories with zero sugar in two places. The official guide says a medium iced is 250 calories and 64 g of sugar, in line with every other flavored fizz. The only zero-calorie fizzes are the plain sparkling water build and the two published sugar-free flavors. A regular Brew Lagoon is a real soda with real sugar. A good one, but a real one.

Is there a sugar-free Brew Lagoon?

Not as a published drink, and this is where people get tripped up. The guide has no sugar-free Brew Lagoon entry. Ocean Breeze, its close cousin, DOES have a full sugar-free version with official numbers, and fans online warn each other that an Ocean Breeze is not a sugar-free Brew Lagoon. Different drink, different status. The syrups exist in sugar-free form, so a stand may build you one, but there are no official numbers for it. Our sugar-free drinks list keeps the published ones straight.

What does Brew Lagoon taste like with cream or cold foam?

Softer and rounder. Cream and cold foam are official toppings on this drink, and cold foam is the lighter touch if you want the effect without weighing the cup down. A white chocolate drizzle over the top is a fan variant that shows up in the groups. The lime still cuts through, so it never turns into a milkshake situation. It tastes like the blue part of a bomb pop grew up a little.

Is Brew Lagoon a secret menu drink?

Not anymore, if it ever really was. One of the top fan guides still calls it a secret menu item, but Brew Lagoon is printed right on the official fizz menu with its formula next to it: lime, blue raspberry, coconut. You can order it by name at the window like any other drink. No code words, no hoping the brewista knows it.
